talentTrees.desc: Hemorrhage is a bleeding effect whose damage depends on the critical hit that triggered it. As a master of bleeding and critical effects, the warrior specializing in this tree will speed up the fight and increase their rage generation while ensuring that wounded enemies succumb to their injuries.

Lethal Poison is a poison that can be stacked multiple times to amplify its effect. As a master of poisons and debuffs, a rogue specializing in this tree can ensure that their prey slowly succumbs to their wounds.

Chaincast rewards mages who can chain skills within a set time limit. The reward is a skill with no cooldown that can trigger conduits for free. Mages who specialize in this tree will ensure that enemies are overwhelmed by a barrage of spells and Spark, where conduits reign supreme.

Sunlight benefits both the priest and their allies by dealing damage with the next final combo attack. A priest specializing in this tree will punish their enemies with the power of light or bless their allies with a barrage of shields and soothing healing.
